newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil may restart Heidrun at weekend.
newsitem.headline: Statoil may restart Heidrun at weekend.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Friday oil production at the 250,000 barrels per day Heidrun field may resume late this weekend at the earliest.
Output was shut in at 0800 GMT on Wednesday after the flare tip fell off the platform.

"We have not started yet," Statoil spokesman Hogne Hognseth said. "We are still investigating the possibility of using the old flare. When that is finally decided we will at best come on stream late this weekend.
"If the flare cannot be used, it will take more time before we can go on stream again," he said.
The flare tip, a safety measure for releasing pressure in the processing facilities, was picked up by a ship late on Wednesday.
Latest figures from Statoil showed that Heidrun produced 249,738 barrels of crude on Tuesday.
